en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, 
(It has been narrated) from Ali Bin Atiyya that he saw
a letter of Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> (sprinkled) with dust (to dry the ink)’.
en.sarwar: 9. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Ali ibn ‘Atiyyah who has said
the following: “He had seen a soiled letter of abu al-Hassan al-Rida, recipient of divine supreme covenant.”
